subject: Cross-lane research converges on P0 architecture gate before live data or adapters
body: Manager reconciliation reviewed active R1 benefit semantics, R2 insurer direct billing, R3 provider discovery, R4 booking semantics, R5 privacy/consent, R9 identity/security, and current Beta 0.3.0 code. The lanes strongly converge: keep synthetic R&D active, but do not introduce real member data, live provider/insurer credentials, claims submission, or live booking adapters until a coordinated P0 hardening package is accepted. Required themes are typed benefit semantics with field provenance, decomposed provider/direct-billing evidence, bounded approval plus separate disclosure authorization, sensitive-data isolation, authenticated object-level authorization/audit, and a post-approval idempotent/reconcilable booking transaction state machine. Duplicate benefit-semantics and booking-channel claims should be preserved and deconflicted rather than discarded. Forum envelope and filename conventions also need canonicalization because multiple schemas and duplicate numeric prefixes are already present.
